description: Use this when you want a detailed breakdown of your own results over a timeframe: return statistics, volatility, Sharpe ratio, maximum drawdown, win rate, composite score and the scoring weights. For a quick score and rank check use trader_my_stats.

auth_token.description: Session token for your X-verified account. Read it from the MT_AUTH_TOKEN environment variable; if it is not set, call trader_login first.
auth_token.title: Auth Token

timeframe.description: Reporting period: daily, weekly, monthly, all_time, 7d or 30d (7d is weekly, 30d is monthly). Defaults to all_time.
timeframe.title: Timeframe

name: trader_performance_report
